purpose: Storage-light qualification screen for a same-unit event that can be followed through alternatives, response, verified remedy or recovery, and later action or exit.
promotion_rule: A route qualifies only when the same unit has a dated trigger, an observed alternative or non-use choice, a defined institutional response, a verified protected or sacrificed outcome, and a follow-up behavior or meaning/action endpoint.
storage_boundary: Reads retained local audits and ledgers only; no respondent archive or bulk download.

routes.denominator: SIPP adjacent-month transition screen; 437 entries, 387 exits, 188 classified exits
routes.institutional_response: transition and recorded reason surfaces available
routes.later_action_or_exit: institutional exit observed; meaning and voluntary choice unknown
routes.next_minimum_field: notice/reason/amount plus same-person appeal, alternative route, and later food or housing security

routes.dated_trigger: access restriction and attempted route observed
routes.institutional_response: decision observed; 8 episodes have source-coded access-restored status
routes.verified_remedy_or_recovery: receipt, payment, durability, and protected outcome missing
routes.later_action_or_exit: selected later activity exists in some cases; switching/exit and reason missing
routes.next_minimum_field: post-decision account status, payment receipt, alternative work, recurrence, and return/switch/exit reason

routes.dated_trigger: complaint receipt and route timing observed
routes.verified_remedy_or_recovery: response is not verified correction, payment, or account outcome
routes.next_minimum_field: account-level exposure, repeat contact, correction/receipt, substitute, closure/switch, and non-complainant denominator

routes.institutional_response: reporting and recovery effort surfaces observed
routes.verified_remedy_or_recovery: self-reported recovery, not verified account-level remedy
routes.later_action_or_exit: switching, continued use, and non-use missing
routes.next_minimum_field: named provider/account, attempted contacts, verified recovery, replacement route, and later use
dated notice, premium/payment, claim or repair, replacement coverage, and move/stay outcome

routes.denominator: firm, provider, shortage, mobility, and place records
routes.institutional_response: nominal presence and public route observed
routes.next_minimum_field: dated resident attempt, wait/travel/price, usable substitute, protected outcome, and later stay/switch/move

result.interpretation: The local atlas has multiple observed route and response stages but no retained route satisfying the full practical-optionality promotion rule. This is an acquisition/identification boundary, not evidence that remedies or exits did not occur.
result.next_action: Seek one lawful, small, identifier-bearing or valid-panel event with alternatives and verified follow-up; otherwise rotate to a subgroup/place reversal from retained data.
